definition: Spark NLP is an open-source text processing library for advanced natural language processing for the Python, Java and Scala programming languages.
details: The library is built on top of Apache Spark and its Spark ML library. Its purpose is to provide an API for natural language processing pipelines that implement recent academic research results as production-grade, scalable, and trainable software. The library offers pre-trained neural network models, pipelines, and embeddings, as well as support for training custom models.
